query: WITH targets AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['exercises','exercise_submissions','quiz_questions','quiz_answers','quiz_attempts','edutech_exercises','edutech_quiz_questions','edutech_quiz_attempts']) AS table_name), counts AS (SELECT t.table_name, (xpath('/row/count/text()', query_to_xml(format('SELECT count(*) FROM public.%I',t.table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint AS row_count FROM targets t), constraints AS (SELECT tc.table_name, string_agg(tc.constraint_type || ':' || tc.constraint_name, ', ' ORDER BY tc.constraint_type,tc.constraint_name) AS details FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc JOIN targets t ON t.table_name=tc.table_name WHERE tc.table_schema='public' GROUP BY tc.table_name), policies AS (SELECT p.tablename, string_agg(p.policyname || ':' || p.cmd || ':' || coalesce(p.qual,'') || ':' || coalesce(p.with_check,''), ' | ' ORDER BY p.policyname) AS details FROM pg_policies p JOIN targets t ON t.table_name=p.tablename WHERE p.schemaname='public' GROUP BY p.tablename) SELECT 'count' AS kind,c.table_name,c.row_count::text AS details FROM counts c UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint',coalesce(c.table_name,''),coalesce(c.details,'') FROM constraints c UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',coalesce(p.tablename,''),coalesce(p.details,'') FROM policies p ORDER BY kind,table_name LIMIT 100;
